mapper.select: SELECT UPPER(si.work_type) AS work_type, si.work_id, COALESCE(a.name, b.name) AS name, COALESCE(a.cover_image_url, b.cover_image_url) AS cover_image_url, COALESCE(a.air_date, b.publish_date) AS release_date, bt.name AS book_type_name FROM series_item si LEFT JOIN anime a ON si.work_type = 'anime' AND si.work_id = a.id LEFT JOIN book b ON si.work_type = 'book' AND si.work_id = b.id LEFT JOIN book_type bt ON b.book_type_id = bt.id WHERE si.series_id = #{seriesId} AND (a.id IS NOT NULL OR b.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY release_date ASC NULLS LAST, si.id ASC
